name: King Louis OG (3.5g) - Classic Cuts
description:
Private Stock is now Classic Cuts - A selection of classic and modern classic varieties curated from a lineage of tried and true genetics. Always hand-trimmed, always grown indoors. Available in 3.5g & select 1g strains. 

_____

King Louis OG has dense nugs, an overwhelming piney smell, and an earthy musk that will have you thinking of your last forest adventure. Bred in part from OG Kush, Louis OG has a very similar spicy kush aroma.
